# unifi_firewall_app_block (Resource)

Manages a CyberSecure **Simple App Blocking** rule (Settings > CyberSecure > Simple App Blocking): block applications or application categories for a set of clients (`type = "DEVICE"`) or networks (`type = "NETWORK"`), optionally on a schedule.

The controller derives the matching firewall policies from this rule (origin `simple_app_block`, one per source zone). They appear as DERIVED policies in the policy table and change only through this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_dpi_application_categories" "all" {}

# Block every application category for one client, always.
resource "unifi_firewall_app_block" "printer" {
  name        = "[Block:internet] Printer"
  type        = "DEVICE"
  target_type = "APP_CATEGORY"
  client_macs = ["6c:3c:7c:00:00:01"]

  app_category_ids = [for c in data.unifi_dpi_application_categories.all.categories : c.id]

  schedule = {
    mode           = "ALWAYS"
    repeat_on_days = []
    time_all_day   = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the rule (shown in the policy table).
- `target_type` (String) What is blocked: `APP_CATEGORY` (the categories in `app_category_ids`) or `APP` (the applications in `app_ids`).

### Optional

- `app_category_ids` (Set of Number) DPI application category IDs to block (see the `unifi_dpi_application_categories` data source).
- `app_ids` (Set of Number) DPI application IDs to block (see the `unifi_dpi_applications` data source).
- `client_macs` (Set of String) MAC addresses of the clients the rule applies to (`type = "DEVICE"`). Case-insensitive, `:` or `-` separators.
- `network_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the networks the rule applies to (`type = "NETWORK"`).
- `schedule` (Attributes) When the rule is active. The UI's "Always" is `{ mode = "ALWAYS", repeat_on_days = [], time_all_day = false }`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `type` (String) What the rule targets: `DEVICE` (the clients in `client_macs`) or `NETWORK` (the networks in `network_ids`). Defaults to `DEVICE`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `mode` (String) The schedule mode. One of `ALWAYS`, `EVERY_DAY`, `EVERY_WEEK`, `ONE_TIME_ONLY`, `CUSTOM`.

Optional:

- `date` (String) A single date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) for one-time schedules.
- `date_end` (String) The end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) of the schedule window.
- `date_start` (String) The start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) of the schedule window.
- `repeat_on_days` (Set of String) Days of the week the schedule repeats on. Each of `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`, `sun`.
- `time_all_day` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active for the entire day.
- `time_range_end` (String) The end time (`HH:MM`) of the active window.
- `time_range_start` (String) The start time (`HH:MM`) of the active window.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using the site and the rule id: <site>:<id>
terraform import unifi_firewall_app_block.printer default:1c087508-9d46-4173-87fd-098f75913811
```
